div.p: REQUIRED ACCEPTANCE TESTS — NOT YET VERIFIED

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; color: rgb(29, 29, 29); color-scheme: dark; interactivity: inert; margin-block: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-top: 0px; min-block-size: 30px; min-height: 30px; row-rule-color: rgb(29, 29, 29); text-rendering: optimizelegibility;

div.p: 1. Commit succeeds, server response disappears → resend SAME ID + payload → recover prior result, never duplicate money.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; color: rgb(29, 29, 29); color-scheme: dark; interactivity: inert; margin-block: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-top: 0px; min-block-size: 30px; min-height: 30px; row-rule-color: rgb(29, 29, 29); text-rendering: optimizelegibility;

div.p: 2. Concurrent repayments or settlement-vs-repayment → atomic guards prevent overpayment / lost history.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; color: rgb(29, 29, 29); color-scheme: dark; interactivity: inert; margin-block: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-top: 0px; min-block-size: 30px; min-height: 30px; row-rule-color: rgb(29, 29, 29); text-rendering: optimizelegibility;

div.p: 3. Reused operation ID + altered payload → key-collision rejection; no financial effect.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; color: rgb(29, 29, 29); color-scheme: dark; interactivity: inert; margin-block: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-top: 0px; min-block-size: 30px; min-height: 30px; row-rule-color: rgb(29, 29, 29); text-rendering: optimizelegibility;

div.p: 4. Stale version, revoked link, expired credentials → reauthorize/reject safely; do not leak old data.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; color: rgb(29, 29, 29); color-scheme: dark; interactivity: inert; margin-block: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-top: 0px; min-block-size: 30px; min-height: 30px; row-rule-color: rgb(29, 29, 29); text-rendering: optimizelegibility;

div.p: 5. App-process restart or crash mid-reconciliation → durable outbox survives. Reinstall/clear-data recovery requires a separate policy.

div.p: PHASE 3 — OPEN ENGINEERING CONTRACTS / TECHNOLOGY UNDECIDED

div.p: Auth/account recovery; server/database vendor; money representation; operation ID & canonical payload fingerprint.
